#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int round;
    std::cin >> round;

    std::vector<int> firstperson(3);
    std::vector<int> secondperson(3);

    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        std::cin >> firstperson[i];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        std::cin >> secondperson[i];
    }

    int solve(int round, std::vector<int>& firstperson, std::vector<int>& secondperson) {
        int win = 0;
        // Append first element to the end for circular comparison
        secondperson.push_back(secondperson[0]);

        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
            int findless;
            if (firstperson[i] <= secondperson[i + 1]) {
                findless = firstperson[i];
            } else {
                findless = secondperson[i + 1];
            }
            win += findless;
        }

        // Remove the appended element
        secondperson.pop_back();

        // Insert third element at the beginning
        secondperson.insert(secondperson.begin(), secondperson[2]);

        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
            if (firstperson[i] > 0) {
                int diff = std::min(firstperson[i], secondperson[i]);
                firstperson[i] -= diff;
                secondperson[i] -= diff;

                if (firstperson[i] > 0) {
                    int diff2 = std::min(firstperson[i], secondperson[i + 1]);
                    firstperson[i] -= diff2;
                    secondperson[i + 1] -= diff2;
                }
            }
        }

        int total_firstperson = firstperson[0] + firstperson[1] + firstperson[2];
        std::cout << total_firstperson << " " << win << std::endl;
        return 0;
    }

    solve(round, firstperson, secondperson);

    return 0;
}
